title: Reasoning
tagline: Chain of thought, sampling and voting, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and search
summary: Models can improve their answers by thinking longer. This course covers chain-of-thought prompting and self-consistency, training reasoning with outcome and process rewards on verifiable tasks, search over reasoning paths, the scaling of test-time compute, and what is known about the faithfulness and limits of model reasoning.

chapters.summary: Training on mathematics and code with automatic checking, and what emerges from long reinforcement learning.

chapters.title: Search over reasoning
chapters.summary: Tree search, planning and Monte Carlo methods for language models.

chapters.title: Faithfulness and limits of reasoning
chapters.summary: Whether stated reasoning reflects the computation, failure modes and open problems.
